Dispatcher: The training crew reviewed some notes on welfare walks, still here and the Companion Animal Travel Desk kept the register aligned with cabin guidance.
Planner: We confirmed that safety takes priority over speed in every journey. The review stayed focused on calm handling, clear checks, and steady handoff notes.
Coordinator: I updated the briefing pack with concise, kind, and actionable guidance for front-line use. The language stays plain so the cabin team can apply it without delay.
Handler: There was a routine review of carrier placement, water access, and comfort markers. The cabin team will continue to monitor animals during flight and report any change at once.
Planner: I noted two traveler files for follow-up and kept the remarks practical. The service line remains dependable and avoids clutter in the handover.
Coordinator: Rosie was entered in the welfare log with the usual care notes. The file shows no concern, only normal preparation and quiet transit support.
Handler: The team checked the boarding sequence and kept the pace measured. We do not push movement ahead of welfare, and the desk will not do so now.
Trainer: The staff also refreshed the phrasing used for owners at check-in. The aim is to keep each instruction brief, respectful, and easy to carry out.
Dispatcher: I will hold the current pattern for the next shift and keep the communication clean. Aurelia Skyways expects dependable companion travel, and the desk is aligned with that standard.
Planner: The record is complete for the present set of movements. We remain ready to assist with the next cabin handoff.
